He grew up in Sweden, holds dual Swedish and Peruvian citizenship, and has a mother who is from Peru. == Trivia == * Part of a select group of players called "Royal Roaders", earned after winning their rookie split in a major region (LEC Winter 2023) * Has a 100% winrate in LEC finals he has played.[https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896294368958644332 Sheep Esports' X Post] ''x.com'' * After his win of the LEC ([[LEC/2025 Season/Winter Playoffs|LEC 2025 Winter]]) with [[Karmine Corp]], he became the third player alongside [[Targamas]] to win the LEC in two different teams, after [[Caps]] and [[Hylissang]]https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896368788301631590 === Individual Awards === * x1 LEC Rookie of the Year (2023) * x3 LEC 1st All Pro Team (Summer 2023, Winter 2024, Spring 2025) * x1 LEC 2nd All Pro Team (Winter 2023) * x1 LEC 3rd All Pro Team (Spring 2023) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
